title: Eliminate high-rate encode regressions versus exact Leopard1 main
description: Exact-main evidence shows Leopard2 legacy-high encode remains roughly 6-20.5% slower in representative cells despite wire-identical arithmetic. Trace validation, staging, plan/schedule, block-IFFT accumulation, final transform, and scatter costs; remove redundant passes/copies and preserve the old coordinate/parity identity. Keep comparisons against an independently linked exact main codec primary.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned counterbalanced exact-main encode cells cover high-rate K across power boundaries, backends, 64 B through 1 MiB, requested parity subsets, tails, batch and reuse. Promoted changes pass legacy byte identity, scalar/SIMD differential, aliases, ASan/UBSan, and do not regress neighboring cells >2%; remaining gaps retain concrete root causes.
notes: Created 2026-07-18 from exact-main evidence: representative legacy-high encode remains 6-20.5% slower than main. Independent worker active on fresh agent/high-encode-main-gap branch; core algorithm/root-cause work has priority over external-library and CUDA experiments.

title: Add scalable allocation-free batch alias preflight metadata
description: The deterministic cross-item safety fix intentionally uses allocation-free O(B^2*(K+R)) pairwise sweeps because the existing batch ABI provides no batch-wide metadata workspace. This is correct but can dominate the plan's 1024+ stripe target. Add a size-queryable caller-owned preflight workspace, explicitly reserved context storage, immutable batch plan, or equivalent bounded design that flattens/sorts all readable/writable/metadata/scratch intervals in O(M log M) or better for M=B*(K+R), with no hot-path allocation. Preserve the current API as a correct fallback, shared immutable inputs, strict whole-batch atomic rejection, UINT32_MAX arithmetic checks, concurrent contexts, deterministic errors and true no-op semantics. Integrate with caller-executor/prewarm work rather than hiding allocation in the first batch call.
acceptance_criteria: Benchmark B=1,8,64,1024 and larger feasible batches across small/large K,R; fast preflight is allocation-free after explicit setup, exact for partial/duplicate/metadata/scratch overlaps and unequal tails, ASan/UBSan/TSan clean, and does not regress small batches more than 2 percent or narrow existing contracts.

title: Reject setup output handles that alias immutable inputs
description: Public setup APIs clear output handles before reading immutable inputs. If context_out aliases leo2_context_options, codec_out aliases leo2_codec_options, or plan_out aliases the original/recovery presence arrays, the clear mutates input metadata and can change validation or create the wrong object. Before the first output write, overflow-safely describe declared readable spans and reject output-handle overlap. Preserve the documented null-on-ordinary-failure invariant; document the exceptional alias rejection where writing null would itself corrupt immutable input. Cover guard pages, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, short/forward option prefixes, presence arrays, normal failure nulling, Release and ASan/UBSan.
notes: Integrated primary fix fad7d6e plus root follow-up 27a01ae. Context/codec/plan setup reject output-handle overlap with declared immutable option/presence spans before first write; ordinary failures retain null-on-failure, while overlap or arithmetic-unrepresentable spans leave the handle untouched. Root follow-up validates the minimum size_t prefix arithmetic before dereferencing struct_size and adds near-UINTPTR_MAX option-prefix cases. Coverage includes exact/forward-extension/v1-adjacent aliases, presence arrays, guard pages, ordinary nulling. Agent GCC Release 2/2 and Clang ASan+UBSan 2/2; root Release focused 2/2 and ASan+UBSan ABI 1/1, diff check clean.
close_reason: Setup self-clobber bug fixed, prefix arithmetic hardened, and focused sanitizer/ABI gates pass in fad7d6e + 27a01ae.

title: Reject shard descriptor arrays that alias writable scratch or outputs
description: Manual API pass reproduced silent wrong parity: leo2_encode accepts original/recovery pointer arrays located inside caller scratch; ValidateEncodeBuffers writes AddressRange entries over those descriptors and execution then consumes corrupted pointers (GF8 K=4,R=2,64B returned success with mismatching parity under ASan/UBSan). Decode has the same second-pass scratch overwrite and restored metadata may alias writable regions. Define descriptor-array spans and lifetime precisely; reject overlap with scratch and writable outputs before mutating scratch; cover encode/decode/plan/batch, partial overlaps, guard pages, tails and sanitizers. Coordinate cross-item rules with .14.3.
notes: Integrated in 263c953. Reproduced pre-fix K=4/R=2 scratch-resident pointer-array case returned SUCCESS with wrong parity. Encode/decode now describe original/recovery/restored pointer-array spans overflow-safely before scratch mutation, reject metadata versus scratch/writable outputs, retain immutable sharing, and protect the entire batch-item array. Tests cover descriptor arrays versus scratch/output, near-UINTPTR_MAX spans, batch metadata, multi-output corruption, and exact parity/recovery after rejection. Agent: GCC13 Release, Clang18 ASan+UBSan, Clang18 TSan public API; focused Release and reduced-field matrices pass. Root after integration: full Release 69/69 and focused ASan+UBSan 6/6.
close_reason: Metadata clobber correctness bug fixed and validated in 263c953.

title: Run authoritative Leopard1-centric full CPU benchmark matrix
description: Run the plan-required production CPU matrix after source freeze: exact Leopard main versus Leopard2 direct/generic/Algorithm4/Algorithm5/AUTO across 64 B..16 MiB, low/balanced/high/padding counts, loss counts, setup and reuse 1/8/64/1024, batch dimensions, scalar/SSSE3/AVX2, code/table/scratch footprint, operation counts, and available PMU/cache/TLB/bandwidth counters. Use isolated pinned ABBA measurements with confidence intervals; split thread/NUMA scaling to .23; report unsupported exact-main R>K cells explicitly. This replaces broad external-library completion as the CPU release evidence gate.

title: Implement static topology-aware batch and NUMA scheduling
description: The current persistent pool uses dynamic atomic fetch-add and no worker affinity. Implement static scheduling for regular batch/transform work, per-worker scratch ownership, detected allowed-CPU topology, optional affinity, first-touch allocation, NUMA-node stripe partitioning, and per-node state where cross-node writes hurt. Preserve caller control and deterministic errors; do not pin unexpectedly unless requested. Validate TSan, oversubscription, cpusets, heterogeneous item costs, 1..available scaling, and external 128-core/multi-NUMA when available.

title: Build production existing-path dispatcher and crossover table
description: The production dispatcher currently uses a few narrow thresholds and does not generally model plan reuse, batch size, thread count, available parity, or loss shape. Build an offline, deterministic crossover table for existing production direct/generic/Algorithm4/Algorithm5/materialized/tiled/pruned paths keyed by K,R,parent,loss count/pattern, shard bytes,batch,reuse,field,backend,threads. Validate held-out exact-main and neighboring cells; no online first-call benchmarking; profile/wire identity must remain CPU-independent. Keep exact-profile research in C10 separate.

title: Make batch cross-item aliasing deterministic and safe
description: Plan/API audit found encode/decode validate scratch/input/output disjointness only within each batch item. Two items may reuse writable scratch/output or overlap another item input; this executes sequentially with thread_count=1 but races/corrupts under a pool, making behavior machine-dependent. Define cross-item alias rules precisely, permit shared immutable inputs, reject every unsupported writable overlap before starting work, keep lowest-index error deterministic, and avoid unbounded hot-path allocation (use bounded caller/context metadata or a size-queryable batch preflight design). Cover unequal shard sizes, tails, item_count boundaries, shared inputs, duplicate scratch/output, partial overlaps, scalar/pool/TSan.
notes:
2026-07-18 integrated cb821e3 and 4e7206e on codex/leopard2. Batch encode/decode now perform a read-only addressability/metadata phase followed by allocation-free whole-batch alias preflight before any item executes; shared immutable inputs remain legal, every writable output/scratch overlap is deterministic LEO2_OVERLAP, later ordinary errors cannot partially execute earlier items, metadata-overlap rejection preserves every scratch byte, and no-loss batch remains a true no-op. Evidence: implementation branch full Release 61/61; strict Clang -Werror 2/2; ASan+UBSan 2/2; TSan 2/2. Root current focused Release passed, then commit 46a? adds 257-item decode plus encode boundary coverage in both thread_count=1/4 contexts and passes. O(B^2*(K+R)) fallback complexity is explicit; scalable caller/context metadata is follow-up leopard-79h.14.5.
Correction to the preceding shorthand: the root large-batch encode+decode regression commit is exactly 9dbb2bd; its focused Release CTest passed 1/1 at current HEAD.
close_reason: Cross-item alias behavior is now defined, preflighted atomically without hot allocation, regression-tested across scalar/pool/tails/metadata/large counts, and clean under Release, strict warnings, ASan+UBSan, and TSan. Scalable preflight performance is separately tracked by .14.5.

title: Cache permanent puncture contribution for dense active locator setup
description: Codec setup currently caches permanent locator evaluations only when sparse-direct construction is preferred. Dense active-N Walsh plans call PrepareDecode on the combined permanent+dynamic+virtual erasure mask each time, contrary to the plan's permanent-contribution reuse requirement. Derive and cache the dense active-Walsh permanent contribution (or equivalent transform-domain state), combine dynamic erasures without changing locator derivatives/reveal factors, and prove exhaustive GF4/GF8 plus broad GF16 add/remove/swap/puncture/virtual-erasure equality, concurrency, setup memory and crossover before production use.
notes: Resolved as a tested negative rather than adding a dominated dense cache. Deterministic survivor selection retains exactly K of K+R transmitted coordinates, so every plan has exactly R non-permanent real+virtual erasures; codec setup's IsDirectLocatorPreferred(N,R) therefore predicts the sparse/direct region exactly. Existing sparse permanent cache saves p*(N-1) additions. Both executable dense candidates (coordinate-domain and post-kernel transform-domain) retain two active-N Walsh transforms and N products while adding N modular additions and N persistent symbols, so union-Walsh strictly dominates. Integrated commits 0e60ca8 and 616eff5. Root Release locator replay: 9,894,532 entries, 9,647 exact-R selection patterns, 256 concurrent shared-base preparations, structural cases at N=2..65536. Worker gates: GCC13 strict Werror 3/3, Debug assertion 3/3, Clang18 ASan+UBSan 3/3, TSan locator pass. Full derivation and reproduction in docs/leopard2_permanent_locator_cache.md.
close_reason: Dense cache rejected by proved operation/pass dominance; existing sparse policy proven complete and guarded by exhaustive tests/debug invariant.

title: Serialize legacy and Leopard2 global initialization
description: Manual audit found leo_init()/leo_init_ unsynchronized: legacy m_Initialized, FF8/FF16 initialization flags/table allocation and backend SelectedOps/qualification state can be read/written concurrently. Leopard2 EnsureInitialized serializes only Leopard2 callers, not a direct legacy leo_init racing context creation. Make the full public initialization boundary process-thread-safe and idempotent with safe publication, preserve version/error/failure behavior, and add high-contention legacy/Leopard2 mixed initialization plus TSan/failure-injection coverage.
close_reason: Commit d121481 serializes the full process initializer, publishes readiness with release/acquire, keeps invalid-version/failure retries non-poisoning, and routes every Leopard2 context setup through the same boundary. Fresh mixed 64-thread legacy/context regression passes integrated Release and TSan (setarch plus documented libomp suppression); audited ASan+UBSan and reduced-field builds also pass.

title: Integrate C1 exact-mask pruning into low Algorithm 4
description: High Algorithm 5 now consumes immutable C1 plans, but production low Algorithm 4 still uses only per-block input prefixes plus the legacy output-dependency bitfield. Compile exact sparse selected-coordinate input masks and requested-original output masks during decode-plan setup, route tiled/materialized GF8/GF16 Algorithm 4 through audited pruned schedules, and test direct-oracle equality, tails, concurrency, sanitizers, setup/footprint and exact-main/neighbor crossovers before dispatch.
notes: Integrated production exact-mask Algorithm 4 pruning in a492648 with documentation in 122d7de. Plan-owned immutable low input/output schedules drive GF8/GF16 materialized and tiled kernels; mature prefix/dependency transforms remain fallback. Agent evidence: strict Clang18 focused 3/3; Release focused core 6/6 and final 3/3; ASan+UBSan focused 6/6 and final 3/3; direct_symbols=18240, plan_exec=24, batch=8, concurrent=64, tails/guards/aliases/rebuild; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 contexts; modeled schedule operations 3696 to 3330. Root current candidate: Release 68/68 excluding separately repaired portable audit, portable 1/1 after 2113a64, focused ASan+UBSan 22/22. Keep open: isolated authoritative crossover/promotion timing and committed raw evidence remain required; shared-host timings are not promotion evidence.

title: Prune sparse requested parity outputs in production encoders
description: High V1 computes a transform prefix through the highest requested parity and Low V1 computes a prefix within each requested parity block, so sparse null-output masks still execute unused butterflies and temporary writes. Add allocation-free planned exact output-mask pruning (or a reusable immutable encode-output plan) for GF8/GF16 high and low encoders, preserving every parity byte, arbitrary tails, requested-subset semantics, backend determinism and no hot-path allocation. Measure setup separately and promote only regions beating mature prefix kernels without neighbor regression.
notes: 2026-07-18 exact sparse-output substrate integrated at d61940d + 0777fd5. It compiles packed two-bit call-local schedules, handles one-row output masks, immutable-source low-rate evaluation, GF8/GF16, tails, bounded 64-KiB scratch and safe prefix fallback. Independent root review accepted the butterfly algebra/traversal and Release 70/70 passed after integration. AUTO deliberately remains on mature prefix transforms; keep this P0 open for setup-inclusive same-source crossover timing, deterministic promotion thresholds, and production-mode activation only where evidence beats prefix without neighbor regression.

title: Remove Algorithm 5 coefficient-block copies and fuse recovery scatter
description: Production high Algorithm 5 still memcpy-copies all T evaluator/coefficient shards into a tile or output block before each requested block transform, then runs a separate inverse-locator multiply/scatter. Reuse the audited immutable-source out-of-place butterfly layer to evaluate from the accumulator without a whole-T copy, and evaluate fusion of the final layer with scatter and output factors. Cover materialized/tiled GF8/GF16, exact sparse output plans, tails, aliases, concurrency, operation counts and exact-main crossover; retain fallback when fusion loses.
notes: 2026-07-18 integrated commits 4dcd887 and 299ab72 on codex/leopard2. High Algorithm 5 now evaluates immutable T-coefficient sources directly through out-of-place root butterflies for prepared/materialized/tiled GF8/GF16 and exact sparse plans; the previous per-output-block whole-T copy remains only as a validated fail-safe fallback. Structural counters require zero fallback; reveal scatter fusion was evaluated and not promoted because the common public gather must retain compact GF16-tail and alias semantics. Root validation at 299ab72: GCC Release full 69/69; Clang/GCC ASan+UBSan focused 10/10; implementation-agent strict Clang18 10/10 and full Release 69/69. Keep in_progress until isolated same-source exact-main/copy-on/copy-off crossover evidence is collected; no authoritative timing was claimed on the shared host.

title: Harden legacy count validation and work-count overflow
description: Manual audit proved leo_encode_work_count/leo_decode_work_count violate their documented zero-on-invalid contract (including zero K and R>K), and leo_decode_work_count(UINT_MAX,2) wraps before NextPow2 then reaches LastNonzeroBit32(0)/__builtin_clz(0) UB. Legacy encode/decode K=1/R=1 shortcuts also bypass documented K+R<=65536 validation. Centralize overflow-safe count checks while preserving valid work counts, legacy result classes, wire output, and supported fast paths; add boundary/reduced-field/sanitizer regressions.
close_reason: Commit fa1410e (source b0ac784) centralizes overflow-safe legacy geometry, rejects zero/R>K/K+R>65536/dyadic-parent overflow/UINT_MAX before pointer traversal, and makes fast paths enforce the computed work geometry. Valid boundary work counts and legacy result classes are covered. Integrated Release public_api_contract, field_options and Leopard2 API tests pass; dual/reduced-field and Clang18 ASan+UBSan gates passed in the audited worktree.

title: Fix legacy K=1 no-loss decode null-parity crash
description: Manual whole-codebase audit reproduced leo_decode(buffer=64,K=1,R=1) with original[0] present and recovery[0] NULL passing availability validation, then entering the K==1 shortcut before the no-loss path and memcpying recovery_data[0]. Correct legacy no-loss semantics must copy/preserve original[0] into work[0] without reading absent parity. Add regression coverage across fields/count boundaries and sanitizer validation without changing legacy wire/error behavior.
close_reason: Commit cdf2211 (source 1b26020) moves legacy no-loss handling before the K=1 parity shortcut, eliminating the null recovery memcpy while preserving recovery and NeedMoreData cases. Regression covers dual-field public API plus FF8-only/FF16-only builds. Integrated public_api_contract, field_options and Leopard2 API tests pass; Clang18 ASan+UBSan focused tests passed in the audited worktree.

title: Remove R=1 and one-output hot-path setup overhead
description: Exact-main all-K diagnostics expose severe R=1 and one-loss gaps. Leopard2 sorts/merges every input range even for one output and routes padded-side-one copy/XOR through transform-sized scratch/layout plumbing. Add a linear one-output overlap validation and direct range-only single-side encode/decode layouts without weakening aliases, tails, field layouts, forced diagnostic modes, or error behavior.
acceptance_criteria: R=1 encode and one-loss decode use range-only scratch and no transform staging in production AUTO; one-output validation is linear and exact; GF8/GF16, arbitrary tails, aliases/overlaps, K=1, large K, concurrency and forced diagnostic modes pass; exact-main pinned cells show a credible improvement without neighboring regression.
close_reason: Commit 8f24962 adds range-only padded-side-one encode/direct XOR-copy decode layouts and exact linear one-output overlap validation. Focused Release 4/4, ASan+UBSan 4/4, TSan 3/3 with documented libomp suppression passed. Explicit input/output and recovery/output overlap regressions pass. Pinned directional K=129/R=1/4KiB versus untouched 2fce390 improved encode 4.116->3.578us (13.1%) and decode 5.264->3.775us (28.3%); parity/round-trip digests match. Exact main remains 6.6%/8.4% faster, tracked by .38.1. Scratch fell to 2112/4160 bytes and no longer scales with shard bytes.

title: Generalize balanced full-loss decode crossover beyond K=128
description: Current AUTO selects generic decode only for exact GF8 K=R=128 full loss, while diagnostics at K=15,16,30,31,32 show generic is about 17-21 percent faster than specialized at 64 KiB and usually about 20 percent faster at 4 KiB. Build a full rate/loss/size/backend crossover map, optimize residual generic/API overhead versus Leopard1, and extend deterministic dispatch only across supported evidence-backed regions.
acceptance_criteria: Pinned exact-main and forced generic/specialized comparisons cover power boundaries and neighbors, fields, backends, shard sizes, partial/full loss and reuse; AUTO selects the faster validated kernel; selected-path tests lock every threshold; no cell promoted from saturated diagnostics alone; correctness/wire/scratch/sanitizer gates pass and target cells beat Leopard1 or retain an explicit root cause.
notes: 2026-07-18 checkpoint f6dee1f fuses inverse-locator reveal and public scatter for the retained GF8 generic decoder only on SSSE3/AVX2 aligned prefixes >=4 KiB. The exact factor/coordinate arithmetic is unchanged; small prefixes, scalar/NEON, GF16, and tails retain scratch reveal. Same-host diagnostic before/after screens found about 11% SSSE3 and 26% AVX2 reduction at 4 KiB and larger wins at 64 KiB; an unconditional 256-byte AVX2 prototype regressed, so the committed threshold retains the old path there. Evidence: Release 70/70; focused GCC ASan+UBSan 5/5; GF8-only/GF16-only builds; OMP1/4 explicit backend tests; independent source/assembly review clean. Keep open for the full boundary matrix, independently linked exact-main result, and generalization beyond K=128.

title: Restore portable runtime-dispatched transform throughput versus Leopard1 main
description: The initial partial 1,853-cell attribution population measured exact-main/current-tree-legacy medians 0.891 encode and 0.919 decode. The later committed complete 2,760-cell all-K diagnostic measured 0.891 encode and 0.926 decode; both point to the same broad portable-backend loss. Isolate baseline control-flow and per-butterfly out-of-line Ops costs versus main whole-translation-unit native kernels. Move sufficiently coarse transform execution into compile-time-specialized SSSE3/AVX2 backend boundaries or an equivalent safe design, while preserving pre-dispatch ISA safety and per-context backend selection.
acceptance_criteria: Fresh exact-main/current-legacy/Leopard2 attribution across all GF8 K and representative GF16 identifies causal kernel costs; scalar/SSSE3/AVX2 remain isolated and wire-identical; strict/static-ISA/sanitizer/concurrency gates pass; promoted coarse-grained kernels credibly beat exact main by at least 5 percent in their target regions with no unexplained neighbor regression over 2 percent, or each residual region has a concrete measured follow-up.

title: Bounded tiny direct systematic encoder and crossover
description: Implement conservative allocation-free direct systematic parity evaluation for tiny high/low Leopard2 codecs in GF8 and GF16, including arbitrary requested parity subsets. Pinned AB/BA crossover data covers threshold neighbors across bytes, batch, reuse, profile, field, and backend; automatic dispatch requires >=5% target gain with no unexplained >2% neighboring regression and always retains transform fallback.

design: Select LEO2_SHARD_LAYOUT_GF16_PADDED_ODD_V1. For odd application payload B, every systematic and parity coordinate physically stores W=B+1 bytes.
